admission: user-authorized bounded local E(F_p) run; prior S3 HTTP 403 and missing .resume gates remain unqualified; no cloud spend

input.candidate_rule: seeded xorshift a in 0..1012 and b in 1..1012, R=aG+bQ

arms.full_only: first F+F representation for each candidate
arms.partial_filter: priority F+F, then F+L, then L+L representation for each candidate, eliminate all large columns with source coefficient witnesses

controls: Same exact 512 candidate points in both arms; source identities checked; every completed row replayed from its original source IDs and in the EC group; anchor log_G(G)=1; exact modular base/augmented rank and target pin; independent-row greedy retention.
expected: Preserve all accepted source records and completed-row summaries, failures/censoring, setup/candidate/verification group additions, lookups, modular filter/replay/rank operations and phase wall time. No positive outcome or performance win required.
limits: The base and large domain are tiny public curve components. This tests natural point decomposition under bounded enumeration, not a general prime-field index-calculus asymptotic. Group-add field arithmetic and memory allocation are not priced into one scalar cost; no speedup conclusion.
